outcome: Survival with major morbidities (bronchopulmonary dysplasia, intraventricular hemorrhage grades 3-4, periventricular leukomalacia, surgically treated retinopathy of prematurity)
cohort: 2646 inborn infants with gestational age 23-33 weeks and birth weight 400-1499 g, without malformations, born at 20 centers in Brazil in 2012-2013
finding: Several factors were associated with unfavorable outcomes (death or survival with major morbidities) in VLBW infants, including lower gestational age, male sex, small for gestational age, low Apgar score, and various neonatal complications.
